# 01 — Render correctness: golden images and empty-crop error

**What to build:** `render` gets tolerance-based golden-image tests (committed small PNGs, regenerated by an explicit command, never silently), so later tonal ops have a safety net. A crop that ends up empty after clamping (e.g. fully outside the image) is an error in core and in `pcr render`/`export` (non-zero exit, JSON error), instead of silently writing the uncropped photo.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Golden tests compare `render` output to committed references with a documented tolerance and print a useful diff summary on failure
- [ ] A documented way to regenerate golden files exists and is never triggered by a plain test run
- [ ] `pcr render --crop` fully outside the image exits non-zero with a clear error kind; partial overlap still clamps
- [ ] `just verify` green
